Rebuilding in the response only means the request was accepted; what is left comes back in restIds, and you call again until it is empty (--wait does that for you). body.description: **記号の書き換えは記事・ページの「作成」でだけ起きる**（更新では起きない）。smartReplace=0（既定）だと em ダッシュ「—」が「--」に、1（変換しない）にしても「—」（数値文字参照）になる。**1 にしても原文のままにはならない。**バイトどおりに入れたいなら、作成したあとに同じ値で更新し直すのが確実。対象は smartReplaceFields（既定で title / text / text_more / keywords / excerpt / tags）
body.descriptionEn: **Punctuation is rewritten only when an entry or page is created**, never on update. With smartReplace=0 (the default) an em dash becomes two hyphens; with 1 it becomes — (a numeric character reference). **Setting it to 1 does not store the text verbatim.** To store the exact bytes, update the object with the same value after creating it. smartReplaceFields lists what it touches (title, text, text_more, keywords, excerpt, tags by default).
